items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He used to play with me when I was with Sam Martin... And we had Albert Martin.

ctx.x: Eddie Dorsey plays bass. The real bright fella.

You ever had a yank? He did do yankin'. He used to play with me when I was with Sam Martin. Joe Watson, you had a sign up there. He was playing when I was with him too. And we had Albert Martin. You had got here Albert Martin. He died there about four or five months ago over in Texas. Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.
Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too. ... We had a band there

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Kid Allen and Albert Martin, he's there too. You remember that Albedroom? Yeah. And Alex Scott. We had a band there, bass player. We had a band there. That's where, you know, left and went to Mexico, you know. And after that, when we come back, when I got a bass player, he left too. He used to wouldn't go nowhere but right up the country. He's kind of his daddy. Yeah, I remember. Tell me his son is almost as good as him now. Who,…
Red Allen has been to Europe with Dude Ori.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I got him one of my little friends, Albert Martin... But I took him away from Judy Forstain and got him with Ali.

ctx.x: I asked him which came first.

We had some band, too. Most of our jobs called for white people. We said. We was up three years before we could play for one color people. And the first time we played for color people when Joe Oliver left from the air. You know, the thing I got in there when I was standing right by Joe Oliver with a fellow drumming him, Buddy Sali. Hit him in the eye with a wheel by the hammer. And you know, I thought Joe would be one eye, you know. And he used to have a man, Carol, all them boys. He must have been around about…
I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.
